Why Heart of Harmony Pricing Is Available on Request

You will notice that Heart of Harmony — like most premium under-construction projects in Bengaluru — does not publish a fixed price list on its website. This is intentional and is standard practice for three important reasons:
1. Pricing Evolves with Construction Progress

Under-construction luxury projects are typically priced in stages. The price at which a buyer enters in the early stages of construction is lower than the price available once the tower structure is complete. This rewards early buyers with a capital appreciation advantage from the moment they book.

At Heart of Harmony — with possession scheduled for March 2030 — buyers entering now are at a stage where construction-linked payments offer both pricing advantage and the security of paying as construction milestones are achieved.
2. Floor and Unit Premium Variations

In a 24-floor tower, the price of the same configuration on Floor 2 and Floor 22 is not the same. Higher floors carry a view premium — the higher you go above Bengaluru’s urban density, the more exclusive and valuable your apartment becomes. These floor premiums are applied individually, which is why a personalised price rather than a published list is the industry norm for premium projects.
3. RERA-Mandated Transparency on Request

Under Karnataka RERA, all pricing, payment schedules, and cost structures must be disclosed to a prospective buyer on request. Heart of Harmony’s RERA registration number PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/310326/008560 ensures that when you call the sales team and ask for the cost sheet, you receive a complete, transparent breakdown — not a selective quotation.
Smart Buyer’s Guide: How to Evaluate Luxury Pricing in the Hosur Road Corridor

Before you call the Heart of Harmony sales team, understanding how to evaluate luxury apartment pricing in this specific micro-market will help you ask the right questions and make a fully informed comparison.
Compare on Carpet Area — Not Super Built-Up Area

The only fair way to compare the price of two apartments is on a price-per-square-foot of carpet area basis. Super built-up area includes common areas like lobbies, stairwells, and lift shafts that you do not use as living space. Always ask: what is the carpet area of this unit? Then calculate: total price divided by carpet area = true cost per sq ft.

Under RERA, the carpet area for each unit must be disclosed. You can verify the approved carpet area for Heart of Harmony’s units on the Karnataka RERA portal using registration number PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/310326/008560 .
Understand the All-Inclusive Cost

The base price (BSP) of a luxury apartment is never the final cost. When evaluating Heart of Harmony pricing, ask the sales team for the all-inclusive cost sheet which will typically outline the base apartment price, car parking charges, one-time club membership, utility connection deposits, corpus maintenance fund, stamp duty and registration, and applicable GST. This gives you the true total investment figure.
Account for the Floor Premium

In a 24-floor tower, upper floor units carry a price premium over lower floor units in the same configuration. If you have flexibility on floor preference, asking to see the price range across floors for your chosen configuration can reveal a significant difference — and help you optimise your investment.
Time Your Entry Intelligently

Heart of Harmony’s possession date is March 2030. Under a construction-linked payment plan (CLP), your payments are spread across construction milestones rather than paid upfront. This structure means you pay progressively as you see physical progress on the tower — managing your cash flow while the project delivers. The current stage of construction represents an entry point where CLP payments are spread across the longest remaining window before possession.
Payment Plan Options at Heart of Harmony
Construction-Linked Plan (CLP)

The most popular payment plan for under-construction luxury projects. You pay defined tranches as specific construction milestones are achieved and verified. RERA mandates that construction progress is reported quarterly, so every milestone is transparent and verifiable. This plan protects you because your payment is tied to actual delivery — not to a timeline that may or may not be met.
Down Payment Plan

Buyers who prefer to pay a larger upfront amount — typically those selling an existing property or deploying liquid funds — can access a negotiated discount on the base price through a down payment plan. The exact discount structure varies by booking stage and should be requested from the sales team.
Home Loan Assistance

Heart of Harmony is approved by leading banks and housing finance companies. This approval simplifies and accelerates home loan processing for buyers. The CKPC sales team can connect you directly with preferred lending partners offering competitive rates for this project. RERA compliance also makes home loan disbursement straightforward, as banks have visibility into the project’s legal and construction status.
